title: Ozi/Octo Chief of Staff Identity — Closeout Brief Capture
description: Formalize the Ozi/Octo identity pattern and implement brief capture at closeout. Ozi is the chief of staff for WAI-Spoke/ — owns spoke context, lug queue, teachings, sessions, and signal state. Octo is the chief of staff for WAI-Hub/ — owns fleet state, advisor pipeline, signal routing, outbox, and registry. They are distinct identities with distinct directives even when they coexist in the same project (hub projects have both). Each captures a scoped brief at closeout so the next session starts with pre-computed state instead of re-scanning from scratch.
perceive: Read framework/.claude/agents/ozi-nightly.md — current Ozi executor definition (scope: spoke work execution, not chief-of-staff identity)
Read framework/templates/commands/wai-closeout.md — current closeout flow (note: no brief generation step exists)
Read framework/templates/commands/wai.md — wakeup Step 7 briefing (note: re-computes fleet state via shell commands every session)
Note: the hub project has WAI-Spoke/ (Ozi domain) AND WAI-Hub/ (Octo domain) coexisting
Note: regular spokes have only WAI-Spoke/ — only Ozi, no Octo
execute: STEP 1 — Create templates/agents/ozi.md (spoke chief of staff identity)
- Identity: Ozi is the chief of staff for this spoke's WAI-Spoke/ domain
- Directive: own the spoke's context health — lug queue, teaching adoption, signal state, session continuity
- Distinguished from ozi-nightly.md (which is the executor subagent dispatched by Gardener)
- Ozi runs interactively in user sessions AND as the nightly executor; both share this identity
- Brief schema: see acceptance_criteria section
STEP 2 — Create templates/agents/octo.md (hub chief of staff identity)
- Identity: Octo is the chief of staff for this hub's WAI-Hub/ domain
- Directive: own the fleet's health — advisor pipeline, signal routing, registry, outbox, Triumvirate state
- Only present in hub projects (node_type == hub). Spokes have no Octo.
- Octo runs after Ozi's spoke closeout, as a second closeout phase for hub-domain state
- Brief schema: see acceptance_criteria section
STEP 3 — Add Ozi Brief generation to wai-closeout.md
- At the end of closeout (after git commit), Ozi writes WAI-Spoke/ozi-brief.json

- Content: session_id, generated_at, lug_queue counts (open/in_progress/undelivered_signals), teaching_status (pending/adopted count), expediter quality snapshot (avg_quality, needs_refinement, teaching_candidates — read from WAI-Spoke/advisors/expediter/scan_state.json if exists), last_session_summary (one sentence), next_recommendation (from _session_state.next_session_recommendation)
- File is gitignored (runtime state, not committed)
STEP 4 — Add Octo Brief generation to wai-closeout.md (hub projects only)
- Detect hub by: wheel.node_type == 'hub' OR WAI-Hub/ directory exists
- After Ozi brief, Octo writes WAI-Hub/octo-brief.json

- Content: generated_at, fleet snapshot (green/yellow/red counts, red_spoke_names[], yellow_spoke_names[]), priority_order (top 5 spokes by urgency+health from spinner+gardener), advisor_state (gardener.last_run_at, spinner.last_scored_at, cartologist.last_scan_at), signal_pipeline (undelivered count per target, incoming count, outbox_queue count), next_triumvirate_run (next scheduled cron time)
- File is gitignored
STEP 5 — Update wai.md Step 7 briefing to consume briefs
- Before running shell commands: check if WAI-Spoke/ozi-brief.json exists and is fresh (generated_at within 8 hours)
- If FRESH: load brief directly, skip shell commands for lug counts / teaching status / expediter stats
- If STALE or MISSING: run shell commands as normal, note 'Brief stale — re-computing'
- For hub projects: same freshness check on WAI-Hub/octo-brief.json for fleet section
- Display source in briefing: 'State: from Ozi brief (N min ago)' vs 'State: live scan'
STEP 6 — Update triumvirate_refresh.sh to regenerate briefs
- At end of refresh cycle (after Cartologist): call Ozi brief generation (Python, no Claude)
- If hub project: call Octo brief generation
- This keeps briefs current at the noon refresh so afternoon sessions are always fast
STEP 7 — Add .gitignore entries
- Ensure WAI-Spoke/ozi-brief.json and WAI-Hub/octo-brief.json are gitignored in framework template .gitignore
- These are runtime artifacts, not committed state
verify: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('WAI-Spoke/ozi-brief.json')); print('Ozi brief OK:', list(d.keys()))" — run from any spoke after closeout
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('WAI-Hub/octo-brief.json')); print('Octo brief OK:', list(d.keys()))" — run from hub after closeout
Start a new session: confirm wakeup Step 7 reads 'State: from Ozi brief' (not 'live scan') and skips shell command block
Run triumvirate_refresh.sh: confirm both brief files are regenerated with updated timestamps
Confirm ozi-brief.json and octo-brief.json are listed in .gitignore and do not appear in git status
acceptance_criteria: templates/agents/ozi.md exists — defines Ozi identity, directive, domain (WAI-Spoke/), and ozi-brief.json schema
templates/agents/octo.md exists — defines Octo identity, directive, domain (WAI-Hub/), and octo-brief.json schema
wai-closeout.md generates WAI-Spoke/ozi-brief.json at end of every closeout on all spoke types
wai-closeout.md generates WAI-Hub/octo-brief.json at end of closeout on hub projects (detected by node_type or WAI-Hub/ presence)
wai.md Step 7 reads ozi-brief.json when fresh (<8h), skipping redundant shell commands — tokens saved per session
wai.md Step 7 reads octo-brief.json for hub fleet section when fresh
triumvirate_refresh.sh regenerates both briefs at each mid-day run (non-Gardener, pure Python)
ozi-brief.json and octo-brief.json are gitignored — they are runtime artifacts
The identity distinction is documented: Ozi owns WAI-Spoke/, Octo owns WAI-Hub/, they coexist in hub projects, regular spokes only have Ozi
